question: Should maintainers accept the startedAt run-generation invariant and rebase/adopt this direct WebChat Stop recovery on the current chat UI surface?
rationale: The fix is well-proven for the direct Stop flow, but it changes session terminalization semantics and the branch is now conflicting after a UI refactor, so maintainer intent is needed before merge or repair.

options.title: Rebase And Keep Direct Fix
options.body: Adapt the client-side reconciliation to ui/src/pages/chat, keep the Gateway lifecycle guard, and leave the compaction variant tracked separately.

options.title: Broaden To Compaction
options.body: Require this PR or a replacement to also prove and fix the Stop plus compaction restartRecoveryRuns path before landing.

options.title: Pause For Unified Session Design
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want one stronger session-generation owner for Stop, restart recovery, and compaction races.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Keep Direct Fix
recommendation.body: Adapt the client-side reconciliation to ui/src/pages/chat, keep the Gateway lifecycle guard, and leave the compaction variant tracked separately.
